initiatives.name: Margie's Hope
initiatives.description: Margie's Hope assists transgender, non-binary and gender expansive individuals in need.

initiatives.name: Meta Center
initiatives.description: META Center Inc. is an Akron-based 501(3) organization that creates regular programming for transgender and gender non-conforming youth ages 7-19.

initiatives.name: Akron Food Not Bombs
initiatives.description: We distribute meals every Sunday to those who need them. Currently serving at Grace Park in Akron.

initiatives.name: Canton Food Not Bombs
initiatives.description: Food Not Bombs is an organization that shares food with those who need it.

initiatives.name: Everyone Deserves to Eat
initiatives.description: Mutual aid and food distros in Akron and Loveland

initiatives.name:
Freedom Taillight
              Project
initiatives.description: Freedom Taillight Project hosts monthly taillight repair/replacement clinics in Akron, OH.

initiatives.name: Trans Joy Akron
initiatives.description: All-volunteer nonprofit in Akron, OH that hosts monthly meetups, events like Trans Day of Visibility and Trans Pride at the Park, and educational programs for the trans+ community.

initiatives.name: Akron Palestine Solidarity Collective
initiatives.description: Akron, OH coalition of groups that pushes Summit County to end investments in Israel Bonds, and holds protests and a lecture series on Palestine.

initiatives.name: Akron ICE Watch
initiatives.description: Coalition of Akron groups, including local DSA, PSL and Indivisible members, that runs know-your-rights trainings, hands out whistle kits and runs a hotline for reporting ICE sightings.

initiatives.name: Akron Bail Fund
initiatives.description: Abolitionist bail fund in Akron, formed in 2022 after Jayland Walker protest arrests. Pays bail, runs a court watch, and won a 2024 settlement on police handling of protests.

initiatives.name: The Big Love Network
initiatives.description: Akron network of organizers, artists and health practitioners working on environmental justice, neighbor-led placemaking and sustainability. Produces the annual Big Love festival and Akron City Repair.

initiatives.name: Serve The People Akron
initiatives.description: Mutual aid group in Akron that supports unhoused people and other struggling residents, and takes mutual aid requests through the ICE coalition form.

initiatives.name: PSL Akron
initiatives.description: Akron unit of the Party for Socialism and Liberation Northeast Ohio, a socialist party. Organizes local campaigns and protests.

initiatives.name: People Feeding People
initiatives.description: Free mobile grocery distribution from a box truck every other Wednesday around Akron and Summit County, working with the Akron-Canton Regional Foodbank. Started after 2022 protests.

initiatives.name: Pink Pistol Akron
initiatives.description: Akron chapter of the Pink Pistols, an LGBTQ gun-rights group. Holds firearm safety and range meetups for LGBTQ people.

initiatives.name: Civic Saturday Akron
initiatives.description: Neighborhood gatherings in Akron, started in 2024 in Highland Square, that focus on civic life and local democracy. Based on the Citizen University Civic Saturday model, with music and local organizations.

initiatives.name: Akron DSA
initiatives.description: Local Akron chapter of the Democratic Socialists of America, with nearly 200 members. Does political education and local campaign work, such as opposing a fracking proposal.

initiatives.name: Akron AIDS Collaborative
initiatives.description: Akron nonprofit, formed in 2000, that works on HIV/AIDS prevention and services for people of color. It runs the Bayard Rustin LGBTQ+ Resource Center.

initiatives.name: Akron 50501
initiatives.description: Akron chapter of the 50501 movement, which organizes protests against the Trump administration in Akron, including local Hands Off and No Kings rallies.

initiatives.name: UA Students for Justice in Palestine
initiatives.description: Student group at the University of Akron that advocates for Palestinian freedom and equality and holds events such as a Palestinian Culture Night.

initiatives.name: Indivisible Akron
initiatives.description: Volunteer-run Indivisible group in Akron that holds monthly meetings, canvasses voters, and holds elected officials accountable.

initiatives.name: Stow Collaboration for Change
initiatives.description: Advocacy group founded in 2020 in Stow and Munroe Falls, OH (near Akron), working on public schools, local politics, racial equity and LGBTQ+ rights.
